usedFor: MarkupGo turns HTML, Markdown and URLs into images and PDFs, and “Create Template” saves a reusable layout.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Template” in MarkupGo
bestTemplate.why: It creates a reusable template from HTML, CSS and context data, so later outputs share one layout.

watchOut: “Create Template” builds from HTML, CSS and context data, so check that content before it runs.
